title: xtlp: A new Stata command for panel local projection
abstract: arXiv:2610.41428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Panel local projection (LP) estimated with fixed effects (FEs) is widely used to evaluate the dynamic effects of economic shocks across countries or regions. However, FE estimation of panel LP models is subject to Nickell bias arising from the predictive structure of LP specifications, even when lagged dependent variables are not included in the regressors. This bias invalidates standard inference based on conventional t-statistics. We introduce xtlp, a new Stata command that implements panel LP with split-panel jackknife (SPJ) bias correction. It removes the Nickell bias and restores the validity of standard statistical inference. The command accommodates a broad range of specifications, including different transformations of the dependent variable, additional control variables, and flexible variance estimators. We illustrate xtlp through empirical applications that examine the effects of financial crises on output.

translated_title: xtlp：一个用于面板局部投影的新型Stata命令
translated_abstract: 使用固定效应（FE）估计的面板局部投影（LP）被广泛用于评估经济冲击对国家或地区的动态影响。然而，面板LP模型的固定效应估计会受到Nickell偏差的影响，该偏差源于LP设定的预测结构，即使回归变量中不包含滞后因变量也会产生。这种偏差导致基于常规t统计量的标准统计推断失效。我们介绍了xtlp，一个通过分割面板折刀（SPJ）偏差校正来实现面板局部投影的新型Stata命令。该命令能够消除Nickell偏差，恢复标准统计推断的有效性。它支持广泛的模型设定，包括因变量的不同变换、额外的控制变量以及灵活的方差估计方法。我们通过考察金融危机对产出影响的实证应用展示了xtlp的用法。
tldr: 本文开发了新Stata命令xtlp，通过分割面板折刀（SPJ）偏差校正消除面板局部投影中的Nickell偏差，从而恢复标准统计推断的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces xtlp, a new Stata command that eliminates Nickell bias in panel local projection through split-panel jackknife (SPJ) bias correction, thereby restoring the validity of standard statistical inference.
